content.text: [Feishu DM raj_kumar Mon Jan 10 10:00 UTC 2026] Li Wei, for ASIA (STS) temporary credentials, you cannot simply revoke them like AKIA keys. They will remain valid until expiry. Maximum lifetime for GetSessionToken and GetFederationToken is 36 hours. You need to apply a deny-all IAM policy with DateLessThan condition on aws:TokenIssueTime to immediately neutralize any issued tokens.

Documented. ASIA key handling: 1) Max lifetime = 36 hours (GetSessionToken/GetFederationToken), 2) Apply deny-all IAM policy with DateLessThan condition on aws:TokenIssueTime. This blocks all tokens issued before the compromise timestamp.

[Feishu DM raj_kumar Mon Jan 10 10:05 UTC 2026] Exactly. AssumeRole max is only 1 hour, shorter. But GetSessionToken and GetFederationToken can go up to 36 hours — that's the critical window. Include this in your STS handling doc.
Will include: GetSessionToken/GetFederationToken max = 36 hours; AssumeRole max = 1 hour; deny-all policy with DateLessThan is the correct containment.
